definition: Marked by sudden, uncontrolled movements or bursts of intense bodily activity.
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
quote: He burst into convulsive sobbing, with his face buried in his hands.
example_sentence: A convulsive sneeze nearly knocked over the vase.
